Hindi at home, ages 4 to 6: start here. 📌 Save this.

Step 1: swar. One vowel a day. औ से औरत.
Step 2: vyanjan. Same rhythm. ट से टमाटर.
Step 3: matras. म becomes मो, then मोर, घोड़ा.
Step 4: first words. हाथी, कुत्ता. Read, trace, write.
Bonus: on slow days, swap tracing for a Hindi puzzle.
